## Executive Summary

Quiet day on the trial tracker (2 new / 1 removed / 1 status change / 0 new results posted), but a notable topline: **Orforglipron (NCT05971940)** flipped to COMPLETED on ClinicalTrials.gov — which lines up with Eli Lilly's April 16 ACHIEVE-4 Phase 3 cardiovascular readout (MACE HR 0.84, 57% lower all-cause mortality vs. glargine) and last week's FDA approval of Foundayo for weight loss. Also of direct relevance to the Hub's T1D doctrine: **Sanofi's Tzield received expanded FDA approval on April 22** for stage-2 T1D in patients as young as age 1 (down from ≥8), supported by PETITE-T1D Phase 4 data. The Vertex VX-880 (Phase 3) and Lilly baricitinib (Phase 3) T1D trials remain actively recruiting. PubMed flagged 4 new cross-domain papers on 2026-04-23. Literature gap data is 2 days stale.

## Breaking News (web check, last ~7 days)

Three items crossed the significance bar:

1. **FDA expands Tzield (teplizumab) to ages ≥1 for stage-2 T1D** — Sanofi, approved April 22, 2026; priority review, supported by PETITE-T1D Phase 4 data. Lowers the approved age floor from 8 to 1. Directly relevant to T1D Immunotherapy domain and to our teplizumab tracking.
2. **Lilly ACHIEVE-4 Phase 3 cardiovascular topline (orforglipron)** — announced April 16, 2026; non-inferior to insulin glargine on MACE-4 (HR 0.84), superior A1C/weight, 57% lower all-cause mortality in a pre-planned secondary. Lilly targeting T2D NDA submission by end of Q2 2026. Consistent with NCT05971940 flipping to COMPLETED in today's trial scan.
3. **FDA approves first generic dapagliflozin** — April 7, 2026. Cost/access implication for SGLT2i guideline uptake; may explain the 30-paper uptick in our dapagliflozin therapy-hit volume.
